title: RET 301 – Actuarial Topics for Canadian Retirement Plans

topics.title: Assumptions
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to analyze/synthesize the factors that go into selection of actuarial assumptions for funding purposes of retirement plans under Canadian pension legislation, regulatory policies, tax legislation, and actuarial standards of practice.

outcomes.text: Describe and apply appropriate techniques used in the development of assumptions for funding purposes
Evaluate and recommend appropriate assumptions for funding purposes
Evaluate actual experience, including comparisons to assumptions

topics.title: Methods
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to prepare valuation results, including required contributions, for various purposes under Canadian pension legislation, regulatory policies, tax legislation, and actuarial standards of practice.

outcomes.text: Differentiate between various purposes for valuing pension plans, including:
Analyze a variety of asset valuation methods appropriate for regulatory purposes
Prepare valuation results for ongoing plans appropriate for regulatory purposes
Prepare valuation results for special purposes, including plan terminations, plan mergers or spin-off, actuarial equivalence calculations and asset transfers
